note: appends the pending id to the primary id list if not already present

note: steps a column through an 8-byte table row, keeping the previous value

name: SceneActorState_StepTableByKind
note: picks a byte table by kind and steps it

name: SceneActorState_StartContactPool
note: on finish, starts a contact actor pool burst and advances the phase

name: GridAttack_Update
note: runs the grid attack update steps and cycles a frame timer

name: TextWindow_SetBounds
note: blanks a text window rect and sets new bounds

name: Bat_UpdateAnimationRequest
note: handles a queued animation entry request and advances a finished sequence

name: Bat_LookupAnimationEntry
note: flags the object and returns a table entry for the current sequence step
counts up and runs a delayed script call when the limit is reached

name: Bat_UpdateActionScript
note: runs the queued action script and updates the counter or flags

name: Bat_ReadScriptValuePair
note: reads an optional pair of script values into two fields

name: Slime_SetStateFlag
note: sets bit 3 in a state flag byte

name: Bee_UpdateSway
note: clamps and oscillates a sway offset with direction steps

name: Bee_ClearActionFlags
note: clears several action flag bits and a script field

name: Bee_ConsumeFlag80
note: if flag 0x80 is set, subtracts 3 from a counter and clears the flag

name: Skeleton_StepPosition
note: steps x or y subpixel offset by direction, snaps fraction to 0x80

note: arms primary collider's cost/flags from current health, resets effect direction

name: SceneActorMotion_RefreshGroundHeight
family: SceneActorMotionView (actor tick subsystem, calls sibling sub_08090AE0)
note: if groundHeight is stale by >511, recompute collider cost via sub_08090AE0, then resync the shadow copy of groundHeight

name: SceneActorCollision_FireSecondaryAttack
family: SceneActorCollision (attack-collider setup, shares sub_0821FF58 call convention with scene_actor_collision.h's ReadAttack* helpers)
note: arms the secondary collider (actor+0x188) with one of two attack-parameter slots picked by flags2D4&0x100, unless the actor is unavailable/dead

note: starts behavior three when linked context flag is set

name: SceneActor_InitLinkedReactionColliders

name: SceneActor_EndLinkedReaction
note: clears context reaction flags and releases player counter contribution

name: SceneActor_InitLinkedSprites
note: loads four linked sprite animations and starts their scripts

name: ActorVisibility_TickRevealDelay
note: keep drawable visible while reveal counter expires

name: ActorContact_UpdateColliderPositions
note: update primary and conditional secondary collider positions

name: ActorBehavior_TickParticipantProgress
note: apply periodic participant effects and track counter progress

name: ActorContact_InitializeBodyAndSecondary
note: initialize body and secondary collider with callbacks

name: SceneActorControl_ResetCollisionFlags
note: clears motion/collider flags on an actor, sets flags2D0 bit 0x100000

name: SceneActorControl_ResetTargetFlags
family: SceneActorControl (actor reset helpers, same family as sub_0809D044)
note: clears flags2D4 bit 0x100, clears SceneActorTargetLink.flags bit 8, zeroes control+0x444

name: RouteActor_UpdateRandomDestination
note: selects a random route destination and resolves terrain height

name: SceneActorControl_ConsumeLiftFlagPenalty
family: SceneActorControl (actor reset/lift-flag helpers, sibling of SceneActorControl_ConsumeLiftFlag sub_080837D4)
note: if the actor's lift flag (flags3D4 bit 2) is set, drops the local player's f4F6 counter by 1 when paletteOffset==0, then clears the lift flag

name: RouteActor_UpdatePlayerDestinationPhase
note: initializes pursuit phase and targets the player position

note: selects an animation every ninety ticks and advances phase

name: RouteActor_UpdateAnimationSequence
note: advances animation sequence until phase five completes
